title: Pumpkin Spice Protein Shake
bodyHtml:
INGREDIENTS

1 scoop of Stellar Labs® Vanilla Protein Powder
2/3 cup unsweetened almond milk, sub: cashew, oat, skim milk
1/4 cup pumpkin purée
1/4 cup plain nonfat Greek yogurt
1 tsp maple extract
1 tbsp maple syrup
1/2 tsp cinnamon
3-5 ice cubes, 3-5 cubes
optional: cinnamon sugar or your favorite topping

INSTRUCTIONS

Combine all ingredients in a blender.
Optional: top with cinnamon sugar or your favorite fun topping.

title: Stellar Labs Chocolate Raspberry Shake [VIDEO]
bodyHtml:
This simple to make Vegan Chocolate Smoothie with Raspberries is Gluten-Free and with just 2g of sugar, guilt-free. The high protein shake mix makes it healthy enough for breakfast, but its smooth, creamy richness makes it sweet enough for dessert.
  Ingredients: 1 cup Almond Milk 30 Frozen Raspberries (about 5 oz) 1 Tbsp. Flaxseeds ½ Tbsp. Cocoa Powder ½ tsp. Vanilla Extract 1 scoop Stellar Labs Vegan Chocolate Protein Powder 3 Ice Cubes
Directions: Blend together in a high-speed blender for 20 seconds or until smooth.   Nutrition Information: Calories: 310 Carbs: 16g Protein 24g Fat 9g Sat Fat 1g Fiber 9g Potassium 263mg

title: Stellar Labs Green Machine Smoothie [VIDEO]
bodyHtml:
Try this Delicious Smoothie! 

INGREDIENTS

⅓ cup Steamed Zucchini
⅔ cup Frozen Spinach
⅓ Banana
1 cup Almond Milk
1 Tbsp. Flaxseeds (or Chia Seeds)
½ tsp. Vanilla Extract
1 scoop Stellar Labs Vegan Vanilla Protein Powder
3 Ice Cubes

 

Directions:

Add all ingredients to a high-speed blender. Blend for 20-30 seconds or until smooth. Pour into a glass and enjoy!

Nutrition Information:
Calories: 357
Carbs: 26g
Protein 26g
Fat 11g
Sat Fat 2g
Fiber 8g
Potassium 354mg

title: Stellar Labs Chocolate Almond Shake [VIDEO]
bodyHtml:
A delicious, creamy, and smooth chocolate treat and easy to digest with no bloat afterwards.

 

 

Ingredients
1/3 medium banana (we like frozen)
1/2 cup unsweetened almond milk 
1/2 cup water
1 Tbsp. cocoa powder
1 scoop Stellar Labs Chocolate Whey Protein Powder
1/2 tsp. vanilla extract
1/8-1/4 tsp. almond extract 5-6 ice cubes
2 tsp. flaxseeds

Directions
Add all ingredients to a high-speed blender. Blend for 20-30 seconds or until smooth. Pour into 1 tall glass and enjoy!
